description: This file defines a configuration class for IBM WatsonX chat integration, including methods to map and prepare parameters, handle prompt templates, and generate API URLs for WatsonX endpoints. It builds on OpenAI chat configurations and customizes behavior for WatsonX models.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for IBM WatsonX chat models, providing methods to support parameter mapping, prompt handling, URL construction, and payload preparation specific to WatsonX deployment.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by the WatsonX chat configuration.

methods.name: bool is_tool_choice_option(self, tool_choice: Optional[Union[str, dict]])
methods.description: Determines if a given tool choice is a valid option.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps standard openai parameters to WatsonX-specific parameters, handling 'tools' and 'tool_choice' transformations.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Obtains provider info (base URL and API key) for WatsonX, fetching secrets if necessary.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs API URL for WatsonX endpoints, handling deployment-specific model URLs and stream flag.

methods.name: dict _prepare_payload(self, model: str, api_params: WatsonXAPIParams)
methods.description: Prepares request payload for deployment models, excluding 'model' or 'model_id' from the body.

methods.name: Optional[str] _apply_prompt_template_core( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], hf_template_fn )
methods.description: Core logic to select and generate prompt templates based on model patterns.

methods.name: Optional[str] aapply_prompt_template( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]] )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of applying prompt templates based on model patterns.

methods.name: Optional[str] apply_prompt_template( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]] )
methods.description: Synchronous function that invokes the core prompt template application.
